meta.question: does the student-sufficiency ranking of candidate discs track the teacher's faithfulness ranking, per group, and does that alignment grow with suffdisc training (co-adaptation)?
meta.method: keep-only sufficiency faithfulness (ERASER sufficiency, RISE insertion) of disc-shaped token subsets, computed on the student and on the teacher, compared by per-image rank correlation
meta.paper: DeYoung et al. ACL 2020 (ERASER); Petsiuk, Das & Saenko BMVC 2018 (RISE); Hooker et al. NeurIPS 2019 (ROAR)
